build_commands.cpp: clang++ -O3 -flto -std=c++20 -pthread benchmarks/cpp/suite.cpp benchmarks/cpp/algorithms.cpp benchmarks/cpp/data_structures.cpp benchmarks/cpp/compute.cpp benchmarks/cpp/memory.cpp benchmarks/cpp/io.cpp benchmarks/cpp/adversarial.cpp -o benchmarks/build/cpp-suite
build_commands.rust: rustc -C opt-level=3 -C lto=fat -C codegen-units=1 --edition=2021 benchmarks/rust/suite.rs -o benchmarks/build/rust-suite

noise_model.spread: interquartile range over the median, larger of the two arms
noise_model.rule: win/loss needs the ratio of medians and the ratio of best runs both outside max(parity, spread, floor/median); otherwise parity

benchmarks.name: regex_matching
benchmarks.missing_feature: Regular expression engine and NFA/DFA automaton compiler in stdlib

benchmarks.name: linked_list
benchmarks.missing_feature: Standard LinkedList / Deque container and operations in stdlib

benchmarks.name: binary_search_tree
benchmarks.missing_feature: Ordered balanced tree map/set (std::set / BTreeSet) in stdlib

benchmarks.name: priority_queue
benchmarks.missing_feature: Binary heap / priority queue data structure and push/pop API in stdlib

benchmarks.name: lock_free_queue
benchmarks.missing_feature: User-space atomic primitives (AtomicInt, CAS, memory orderings)

benchmarks.name: async_event_loop

benchmarks.name: mutex_contention

benchmarks.name: work_stealing_pool

benchmarks.name: simd_vector_ops
